query: The lender's AI examined the training data for possible biases that could lead to discrimination against protected groups.
The provider took appropriate measures to detect, prevent and mitigate the biases identified in the model.
The training, validation and testing data sets are relevant, sufficiently representative and as free of errors as possible for the intended purpose.
The credit-scoring system is transparent enough for the bank's staff to interpret its output and use it appropriately.
The model achieves an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity and performs consistently throughout its lifecycle.
The system is resilient to errors and prevents biased outputs from feeding back into future inputs through feedback loops.
Before deploying the credit-scoring AI the deployer carried out an assessment of the impact on fundamental rights.
An AI system that evaluates the creditworthiness of natural persons or establishes their credit score is classified as high-risk.
Instructions for use must state the level of accuracy and its metrics against which the high-risk system was tested.
Training and testing data must be subject to data governance and management practices appropriate to the intended purpose.
